vein_miner.setting.enabled.tooltip: Off breaks one block at a time, as vanilla does.
vein_miner.setting.require_sneak.tooltip: On: hold Shift to vein-mine, and a plain break takes one block. Off (the default): every break of an ore or a log takes the whole vein.
vein_miner.setting.max_blocks.tooltip: The most blocks one break may take. The rest of a longer vein is left standing.
vein_miner.setting.mine_ores.tooltip: Ores, deepslate ores and ancient debris: all connected ones of the same kind.
vein_miner.setting.mine_logs.tooltip: Logs, wood, stems and hyphae of the same tree kind. Leaves are left to the game.
vein_miner.setting.connect.tooltip: Which neighbours belong to a vein. Diagonals catch veins that run corner to corner.
